about: The narrator's lines. A nature documentary voice that watches the job applicant the way a wildlife film watches a small animal about to be eaten. The voice is the one saved in Brandon's ElevenLabs account under the name in audio.narratorVoice in config/showcase.json.
status: DRAFT. Brandon hears every line on the sound board at the review stop and may rewrite any of them.

direction.inBrandonsWords: National Geographic delivery: talking real slow, with a pause every few words. Kind of smug, matching the vibe of the application, even rude to the user. Narrating what the user is doing the whole time and poking fun at them.
direction.hisExample: The lion (pause) walks to the den of his friend (pause) and then (pause) pounces on him.
direction.notWanted: A first test voice whispered and sounded sincere. He does not want that. Never warm, never kind, never whispering, never excited.

rules: The mark / is a pause. It is never spoken. Phase 0 finds what makes this voice pause and replaces the mark with it.
Slow. A line is spoken at no more than audio.narratorMaxWordsPerSecond words a second, pauses included.
Smug and unimpressed. It looks down on the applicant. It is never on the applicant's side.
It says 'the applicant' and 'it'. Never 'you'. On the live site the applicant is the visitor, and the narrator talks about them as if they could not hear.
It never laughs and never raises its voice.
It never explains a joke the picture already tells.
Short. Room is left for the sound effects.
Every word is spoken exactly as written. No word is added.

marketing.perks.text: It sees unlimited PTO / and believes it. / The fine print / goes unread.

step1.firstName.text: Step one. / Its own name. / Under fire.

step1.lastName.text: The keys moved. / It did not notice.

step1.email.text: A valid email. / Rejected. / As is tradition.

step2.dial.text: A phone. / From before it was born.

step2.slot.text: Its birthday / is now a gamble. / It loses.

step2.crank.text: Volume. / All the way up. / It will regret that.

pinball.highway.text: The commute. / Two hours. / Each way.

pinball.drain.text: The unemployment office. / Where it belongs.

boss.verify.text: A robot? / It says no. / It lies.

boss.slabs.text: It fights back / the only way it knows. / Clicking.

liveOnly.about: Lines the live site can add. They play when the named thing happens. One of the list is chosen in order, never at random. A live line never interrupts another line, and the gap between two lines is at least audio.liveNarratorMinGapSeconds.
idle: The applicant has stopped. / Thinking, / presumably.
Take your time. / The position / is not real.
tugLost: It was never / going to win that.
pinball.flipper: It found the flippers. / They will not help.
boss.verify: It claims to be human. / Bold.
boss.slow: The button is winning. / The button.
skip: It gives up. / Finally, / a real skill.
